requirements.statement: Verification steps (/implement-trd's verification pass and /verify-build) and ship steps (/ship-build and its primitive contracts) read every owner-governed rule file from origin/<base>, not from the feature branch's copy. Must pass.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O1 (issue #90; workplan brief Feature 2 acceptance (1))

requirements.statement: When the feature branch's copy of an owner-governed rule file differs from the base copy, the step names the file and the difference loudly (a printed line and an ISSUES line) and carries on, using the base copy whenever the base changed the file since the branch was cut, and never fails the run over it. Must pass.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O2 (issue #90; brief acceptance (2); decision by Forge 2026-11-08)

requirements.statement: A branch copy identical to the base copy behaves exactly as today: the step reads .claude/rules/<file> itself and reports nothing.
Tests that build a fixture git repo (a bare origin, a base branch and a feature branch) cover the differing case and the identical case. Must pass.

In a fixture repo where origin/main later changed verification.md's 'Coverage floor: 50%' to 80%, resolve returns a use whose content is the base copy, a notice naming verification.md and origin/main, and functional-verification.js read-coverage-floor on the path output reads 80 (a branch-copy reader would read 50).
requirements.source: TRD Intended Change, Checkable outcomes, bullet 1

requirements.statement: Identical copies return use: ".claude/rules/verification.md", differs: false, and no notices.
requirements.source: TRD Intended Change, Checkable outcomes, bullet 2

requirements.statement: A branch-only edit keeps the branch copy, with a notice.
requirements.source: TRD Intended Change, Checkable outcomes, bullet 3

requirements.statement: resolve and path exit 0 in every comparison outcome; nothing about the comparison fails the run.
requirements.source: TRD Intended Change, Checkable outcomes, bullet 4

requirements.statement: A stale branch copy must not fail the run; the base copy is read and the difference reported (Forge's call 2026-11-08, recorded as an OWNER-CALL; owner may overrule).
requirements.source: TRD Decision and Open Questions OQ-1

tasks.description: Add owner-rules.js (resolve and path exports and CLI, three-way merge-base comparison, base lookup order, fallbacks) with Jest tests over a fixture git repo; ship it to packages/full/lib/ (symlink) and .claude/lib/ (copy). Acceptance: fixture repo (bare origin, main, feature branch): base-only change gives use = base content, notice naming file and origin/main, read-coverage-floor on path output reads base floor; identical gives use .claude/rules/verification.md, no notices; branch-only gives branch copy with notice; both changed gives base copy with notice; no remote / no base / root not git top level gives branch copy, one notice, exit 0. File list equals AUTHORED_RULES in scaffold-project.sh. Tests fail if resolve returns branch path on base-only change. Serves O1, O2, O3, O4. Dependencies: none.

Wire the verification steps: /implement-trd (section 3.6a runs resolve first and puts notices in ISSUES; check-verification-unfilled, read-coverage-floor, section 8.3 stackHints reads and the live-task evidence refresh instruction read via owner-rules.js path), /verify-build (step 2 and --chained), and contracts/functional-verification.md (loop agents read verification.md and stack.md via the path form). Acceptance: the three files (core and vendored, identical) name owner-rules.js; no read of .claude/rules/verification.md or stack.md in the verification pass is left naming the raw path; a notice is an ISSUES line, never a stop. Serves O1, O2, O3. Dependencies: FIX-001.

Wire the ship steps: /ship-build runs resolve before Step 3, passes "$(owner-rules.js path ship.md)" to ship-sequencer.js start --policy, and puts notices in ISSUES; ship-primitive-release.md reads verification.md and ship-primitive-close-issue.md reads stack.md via the path form. Acceptance: ship-build.md and both contracts (core and vendored, identical) name owner-rules.js; --policy no longer takes .claude/rules/ship.md. Serves O1, O2, O3. Dependencies: FIX-001.

A wiring test asserting the verification and ship files call owner-rules.js and read through it, and that each vendored copy equals its source; CHANGELOG Unreleased entry. Acceptance: test fails if any wired file drops owner-rules.js or hands .claude/rules/ship.md to --policy; CHANGELOG names issue #90. Serves O1, O4. Dependencies: FIX-002, FIX-003.

open_questions: OQ-1 | Should a stale branch copy fail the run instead of being reported? | No — read the base copy and report (Forge's call 2026-11-08, recorded as an OWNER-CALL) | owner-only
could_not_verify: That a live /verify-build session follows the new prose — Jest proves the instruction is present, not that a model obeys it.
The Storybook reproduction itself (another product's develop branch) — reproduced in shape by the fixture repo, not on that repository.
